2610.05140.title: AutoSciBench: Autonomous Benchmark Generation for Evaluating Scientific Agents
2610.05140.paper_summary: As agents rapidly evolve, existing benchmarks can become saturated, limiting their ability to distinguish capabilities and reveal remaining failure modes. Particularly in scientific domains, constructing and updating benchmarks requires substantial time, labor, and domain expertise, making it difficult to keep evaluation aligned with advances in agent capabilities. We address this challenge by investigating whether scientific-agent benchmarks can be automatically generated and iteratively adapted as agent capabilities evolve. We introduce AutoSciBench, a framework that represents each task as a high-level concept specifying the scientific domain, data modality, and required reasoning approach, together with a low-level recipe specifying how the question, environment, and ground-truth answer are constructed and verified. Agents attempt to solve each task, producing solver trajectories and corresponding judge feedback which AutoSciBench uses to revise the recipe or concept, closing observed shortcuts and shifting tasks toward raw-data re-examination, interpretation of intermediate results, and evidence integration. Experience distilled from completed refinement trajectories further guides new concept generation, allowing lessons from earlier task refinement to inform subsequent benchmark construction. Starting from existing benchmarks, we evaluate AutoSciBench across computational biology, materials science, and clinical imaging. Generated benchmarks reduce average solver accuracy by 22.4 and 25.5 percentage points relative to the human-curated benchmarks in computational biology and materials science, respectively, while generated tasks receive higher average quality ratings across all three domains, suggesting that scientific-agent evaluation can adapt as agent capabilities advance.
2610.05140.paper_summary_zh: 隨著代理的快速演變，現有的基準可能會變得飽和，限制其區分能力和揭示剩餘失敗模式的能力。尤其在科學領域，構建和更新基準需要大量的時間、勞力和領域專業知識，這使得評估難以與代理能力的進步保持一致。我們通過研究科學代理基準是否可以自動生成並隨著代理能力的演變進行迭代調整來解決這一挑戰。我們介紹了AutoSciBench，一個將每個任務表示為高級概念的框架，該概念指定了科學領域、數據模態和所需的推理方法，並附有一個低級配方，指定如何構建和驗證問題、環境和真實答案。代理嘗試解決每個任務，產生求解者軌跡和相應的評判反饋，AutoSciBench利用這些信息來修訂配方或概念，關閉觀察到的捷徑，並將任務轉向原始數據的重新檢查、中間結果的解釋和證據整合。從完成的精煉軌跡中提煉的經驗進一步指導新的概念生成，使得早期任務精煉的經驗能夠為後續基準構建提供參考。從現有基準開始，我們在計算生物學、材料科學和臨床影像學中評估AutoSciBench。生成的基準在計算生物學和材料科學中，分別將平均求解者準確率降低了22.4和25.5個百分點，相較於人工策劃的基準，而生成的任務在所有三個領域中獲得了更高的平均質量評分，這表明科學代理評估可以隨著代理能力的進步而調整。
